book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.cra: The [](item://occultism:familiar_glove) is an upgraded version of the [Familiar Ring](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_familiar_ring), capable of holding up to 6 familiars at once instead of just one.

When combined with [Gray Paste](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_gray_paste) in the off-hand, it allows you to
 launch small fireballs in the direction the player is looking.
\
\
When dispensed by a Dispenser, it launches a large fireball.

Flaming Paste is a versatile flammable paste created with
 the help of [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#](), capable of manipulating fire and lava.
 It can be used to set creatures on fire and transmute certain items.
\
\
With a [#](AA00AA)Right-Click[#](), it can be used to create fire and perform ignition
 actions compatible with [](item://minecraft:flint_and_steel). Additionally, [#](AA00AA)Shift-Right-Click[#]() makes it function as a [](item://minecraft:lava_bucket).

The property of interacting with dusts can be combined with the powers of the [Nature Paste](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_nature_paste),
 holding the [](item://occultism:gray_paste) in the off-hand will allow you to interact with
 some minerals, making them grow and extracting extra resources from them.

[Familiar Ring](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_familiar_ring) are very interesting accessories, but they don't provide any real
 protection to the wearer. As an alternative, Silver Armor can be upgraded
 to its Infused version using [](item://occultism:spirit_attuned_gem) and [](item://occultism:soul_gem).
\
Familiar effects will be applied while the armor is equipped.

Otherworld resource can usually only be mined with under the [Third Eye](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@third_eye) effect.
\
Brittle [](item://occultism:spirit_attuned_gem) can be a solution to this fruit addiction problem.
 Tools made of these material can collect basic Otherworld resources even when they are hidden from view.
 \
 \
They also function as [Familiar Ring](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_familiar_ring) when held.

Advanced Otherworld Ores usually can only be mined with Otherworld metal tools.
 The [](item://occultism:infused_pickaxe) is a makeshift solution to this Chicken-and-Egg problem.
 While housing a [#](AA00AA)Familiar[#]() that allows harvesting the,
 but the durability is low. A more durable version is the [Iesnium Pickaxe](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/iesnium_pickaxe).

Research Fragment dust is an enhanced ingredient for rituals.
 It is crafted using the essence of the [#](AA00AA)Foliot[#]() and
 requires magical materials from the Overworld.
Click to change book current category.
If this device has a compass named [#](AA00AA)BACK[#]() inside, it will save your current position before teleporting.

Portal blocks are really cool, but they aren't always practical, such as when you need to get back home.
\
Because of this, a pocket-sized version of the teleporters was developed.
\
With the added benefit of a small internal inventory that can hold up to 9 compasses.
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.get: Makes aquatic creatures friendly toward you.
Allows you to perform extra jumps in mid-air.
Increases the amount of experience dropped.
Converts part of your damage into magic damage and increases the effectiveness of healing received.
Makes illager, arthropod and creeper friendly toward you.
Blocks that can be mined with a pickaxe are broken at a fixed speed.
Makes warden, enderman, shulker and vex friendly toward you.
Makes undead and nether creatures friendly toward you.
Endermen won't become hostile when you look them in the eyes.
Sneaking prevents you from falling off blocks, even with increased step height.
Each level slightly increases step height. Apply [Step Blocked](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@step_blocked) when sneaking.
Allows you to see and interact with basic materials from the Otherworld.
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.pen:
To obtain the essence of a [#](AA00AA)Marid[#]() for [](item://occultism:chalk_blue) you need to
 [summon and kill an Unbound Marid](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/summoning_rituals/marid_essence).

To obtain the [](item://occultism:cruelty_essence) for [](item://occultism:chalk_brown) you need to
 [summon and kill a Mercy Goat](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/possession_rituals/possess_goat)

To obtain the [](item://occultism:cursed_honey) for [](item://occultism:chalk_orange) you need to
 [summon and kill a Possessed Bee](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/possession_rituals/possess_bee)

To obtain the [](item://occultism:demonic_meat) for [](item://occultism:chalk_pink) you need to
 [summon and kill a Possessed Zombified Piglin](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/possession_rituals/possess_zombified_piglin)

To obtain the essence of an [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]() for [](item://occultism:chalk_red) you need to
 [summon and kill an Unbound Afrit](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/summoning_rituals/afrit_essence).
